batch.description: Transcribed 2026-10-31 from the compiler-solved scan in the AdmissionWar/Google Drive PDF ju-a-2013-2014-set3.pdf (5 pp.). The printed header (p.1) reads: A3-ইউনিট, গাণিতিক ও পদার্থ বিষয়ক অনুষদ (Faculty of Mathematical and Physical Sciences), জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়; ১ম বর্ষ (সম্মান) ভর্তি পরীক্ষা, ২০১৩-২০১৪; বিষয়ঃ পদার্থ বিজ্ঞান (subject: Physics) — boxed 'Set CODE: 1', সময়: ৪৫ মিনিট, পূর্ণমান- ৬০. The paper id follows the printed sub-unit and subject (ju-a3-…-physics-set1, mirroring the project's ju-d2-2013-2014-set3 sub-unit precedent); the Drive listing label 'Set-3' is just the archive's sequence number. 60 questions with no printed subject sections, subjects assigned per question by content: English Q1-7 (7), Bangla Q8-15 (8), Physics Q16-45 (30), Higher Mathematics Q46-60 (15). A printed group direction covers the English gap-fill items Q1-6. KEY FORM: the compilation prints a boxed key beside each question (উত্তরঃ + Bangla letter; 'Ans:' for the English items), but this copy leaves the box EMPTY for 19 of the 60 questions — all seven English items (Q1-7), Q15, Q39, Q46, Q47, Q48, Q50, Q51, Q56, Q57, Q58, Q59 and Q60 — and one further box (Q13) is illegible under the aggregator logo; those 20 questions are recorded keyless rather than guessed (each verified on zoomed crops, including red-channel crops that suppress the orange watermark). 40 questions are keyed. Several printed keys appear to be compiler key errors (e.g. Q21, Q41) and are preserved as printed, flagged on the questions. Transcription was made from own 300-dpi renders of the PDF, SHA-256-verified against the project render copies. Extraction-stage pack: content and answers unverified pending cross-source verification. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.notes: CamScanner scan of a compiler-solved reprint of the JU A3 Unit 2013-2014 Physics subject paper (Faculty of Mathematical and Physical Sciences; printed Set CODE: 1). Aggregator header 'Download More Question Bank From www.admissionwar.com', footer 'Get All University Admission Update From www.admissionwar.com' and diagonal 'Admission War' watermarks are the aggregator's, not part of the question paper. A handwritten circled '10' on p.1 and pen ticks beside some options are readers' marks, not print. Unusually for this compilation series, many printed key boxes are empty (see batch description); every keyless question was verified on zoomed crops before being recorded keyless.
